scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays MirDB logo, tagline, value proposition, and primary CTAs correctly (REQ-1, REQ-4)

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL
steps.context: User lands on the MirDB homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the MirDB animated logo (logo.gif) is visible in the hero section
steps.context: Logo should be properly sized and positioned

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should be prominent and readable

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and clickable
steps.context: Buttons should be visually prominent and interactive

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains MirDB logo image (logo.gif), tagline text, value proposition description, and at least two CTA buttons
User is redirected to the MirDB GitHub repository
CircleCI status badge is visible and shows build status

test_cases.input: Render hero component with required props
test_cases.expected: Component renders without errors and displays all required elements

scenarios.name: Key Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify the key features section showcases persistence, memcached protocol, and LSM-tree architecture (REQ-2)

steps.description: Navigate to the key features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be visible below the hero section

steps.description: Check that feature cards are displayed for each core capability
steps.context: Cards should highlight Memcached Protocol, Persistence, LSM-Tree, WAL, and Compaction

steps.description: Each feature card should have a title and description
steps.context: Descriptions should clearly explain the benefit to users

test_cases.input: Load features section and count feature cards
test_cases.expected: At least 5 feature cards are displayed: Memcached Protocol Compatibility, Persistent Storage, LSM-Tree Architecture, Write-Ahead Log, Configurable Compaction

test_cases.input: Verify feature card content for 'Memcached Protocol Compatibility'
test_cases.expected: Card contains title and description explaining compatibility with existing memcached clients

test_cases.input: Verify feature card content for 'Persistent Storage'
test_cases.expected: Card explains that data persists unlike vanilla memcached

test_cases.input: Verify feature card content for 'LSM-Tree Architecture'
test_cases.expected: Card describes the LSM-tree storage engine with 7-level compaction
